title: Rio Tinto second-quarter 2026 production results
excerpt: First-half copper-equivalent production rose 3%; Oyu Tolgoi first-half production rose 31%; group second-quarter copper production was 213 kt, down 7% year over year and sequentially; and 2026 copper guidance remained 800-870 kt.
summary: The issuer release confirms improving Oyu Tolgoi ramp economics and diversified volume growth while showing lower group quarterly copper output, continued iron-ore dominance, and substantial project execution exposure.
